import math, subprocess
def fib(n):
    a,b=0,1
    for _ in range(n): a,b=b,a+b
    return a&0xffffffff
tests = [208, 20000, 1000000, 100000000, 1000000000, 2147483647, 4294967295, 152587890625&0xffffffff, 65535*65535, 65536*65536-1, 100, 144, 169, 196, 225]
for n in tests:
    n32 = n & 0xffffffff
    expected = fib(math.isqrt(n32))
    result = subprocess.run(['./sim', str(n32)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    got = int(result.stdout.strip()) if result.stdout.strip() else 'ERR'
    status = 'OK' if got == expected else 'FAIL'
    print(f'{status} N={n32} isqrt={math.isqrt(n32)} expected={expected} got={got}')
"
